office_does: Hears and decides misdemeanor cases for the City of Seattle for a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: sitting Seattle Municipal Court Judge Damon Shadid, on the court since 2014, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Seattle Municipal Court judge since 2014 and its Assistant Presiding Judge, whose work has centered on the Mental Health Court, Community Court, and Consolidated Calendar.
highlights: On the Seattle Municipal Court since January 2014; Assistant Presiding Judge [S2]
Presided over the Mental Health Court for four years; started the Consolidated Calendar [S1][S2]
Working with the City Attorney and public defense on the new Connection Court [S1]
